Part 1 
 
Figure 79 Leader Board Entry Page 
Part 2 
 
Figure 78, is shown to you at the start of each week, this will ask you if you 
would like to compete, by pressing get started you are opting into the 
competition. To retreat, you can press the back button on your device. 
If your rank has progressed, you will be shown Figure 79, this page will tell you 
what your new rank is. Press continue to go into the leaderboard page.
